message.content: {"4": {"original": "Foxtel and Village Roadshow plan to block over 50 websites, while operators of 5", "rephrased": "The copyright holders, Foxtel and Village Roadshow, intend to enforce the court order by blocking more than 50 specific websites, a strategy that expands the initial mandate to cover over 50 domains rather than the five originally ordered. This aggressive expansion of the blocking scope will inevitably include sites like SolarMovie and various Linux distribution platforms, which rely on open-source software for operating system downloads, thereby risking the disruption of legitimate users who depend on these services for accessing freely licensed content.", "summary": "Copyright holders plan to block over 50 websites, including legitimate open-source Linux distributions, risking disruption to users who rely on these services."}}
